Designed to store liquid and will hold a maximum of 20 sips, though some special containers are offered that are unlimited.

Any dwarven merchant may unlock this item and any Ale Festival Merchant may as well.

The noun must remain horn or tusk.  The overall design must remain dwarven in nature.  Bandings, tips, and ornaments made of common dwarven materials like invar, mithril, and glaes, are encouraged in their descriptions.  Dwarves also like gems; feel free to adorn them with all types of gemstones found across Elanthia when altering these items.  Mundane and magical creatures alike throughout Elanthia can be used for the primary material of these drinking vessels as long as they have large enough horns or tusks to drink from.
